'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Bill Kafer DS Endor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' 'Da Muthafuckin Bombers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
